tone.target: wah-funk guitar with chewy midrange and tight bite
tone.profile: wah-funk guitar with chewy midrange and tight bite
tone.summary: A classic funk/R&B tone built around a clean Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) and Wah pedal, emphasizing tight percussive attack and midrange punch.

blocks.purpose: Tightening up the percussive muting and eliminating hum.
Providing a slight lift and punch to the attack without adding grit.
blocks.gap: A dedicated clean boost (like an LP booster) would be ideal, but Boost serves the function well.

blocks.purpose: The signature element: rhythmic wah sweeps and midrange emphasis.
Keeping the tone clean and bright; no distortion needed.
Simulating the clean, bright Fender/JC style amp required for funk.
Providing the tight, focused sound of a smaller cabinet suitable for funk.
Boosting the chewy midrange and adding bite while controlling low-end mud.
Keeping the tone dry and punchy; Chorus is explicitly avoided.
Keeping the tone dry and percussive; delay is not essential for this style.
Adding minimal space and depth without muddying the tight funk rhythm.
blocks.gap: A Plate reverb might be slightly cleaner, but Room works for subtle ambience.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for tighter, more focused funk tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance percussive attack and midrange focus for funk genre.
